## Purpose

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link any related issue.

## Scope and evidence

- Changed code/resources or locale and official terminology sources:
- Actual commands/results, browser/native coverage and environment limits:
- Human translation review and remaining gaps, if applicable:

Include required deterministic product resources. Exclude saves, personal
exports, logs, build output and local archives. Leave version selection and
publication to the maintainer. See CONTRIBUTING.md and docs/TRANSLATING.md.
